projects.name: sales-intelligence-platform
projects.summary: Ran the PR review pipeline over roughly 60 PRs for a product still in alpha: Morning brief, Bookings live layer, Rank in Motion, Actions from Ask, and related hardening. Haircut covers config-only and doc-only PRs.

projects.name: spark-mobile-app
projects.summary: Reviewed and fixed the PR 6 to 8 stack, ran the review pipeline on PRs 97 to 182 (offline caching, TestFlight workflow, Calendar epic, realtime voice detection, beta hardening, four lightning-round bug sweeps), and generated a local iOS Xcode project under the enterprise team.

projects.name: app-distribution-website
projects.summary: First deployment to Railway, temporary access password, users/roles/groups administration, icon upload, archived-app delete, and Auth0 PKCE login with the Okta connection claim.

projects.name: claude-setup
projects.summary: Documented Codex CLI and MCP prerequisites, verified the Codex 0.149.1 Azure fix, migrated the cross-model pipeline to gpt-6-astra, tuned prompts, hardened tests, removed the GitHub plugin, cleared the TODO backlog.

projects.name: pr-review-pipeline
projects.summary: Built and published the PR review pipeline plugin as a public repository, added the claim protocol and status command, shipped v1.1.0 and v1.1.1; 19 automated sandbox test runs folded in.

projects.name: ai-command-center
projects.summary: Closed hand-test findings on the program-targets feature branch (Economics section, whole-page save), then designed and opened a PR for the simplified ROI scorecard table view.

projects.name: price-compare-extension
projects.summary: Packaged the 0.22.0 store release (host move, PennVet, alarms) and reworked the new chunked order-history sync to accumulate locally before uploading to ICS.

projects.name: inventorybuddy
projects.summary: Reviewed and merged PR 168 (receiving dispense-quantity flow with telemetry build version), then ran the pipeline on PRs 171 to 173 (file-based catalog cache, cache-write resilience, zero on-hand mapping) for the TestFlight-only beta; one pull-latest sync.

projects.name: status-page
projects.summary: Reviewed and merged PR 28 (incident display), PR 34 (internal status page), and PR 35 (multi-product deployment serving Pulse and Comms from one image).

projects.name: b2b-ecommerce-cc
projects.summary: Evaluated the VetSuite codebase: pulled main, ran tests and a production build smoke check, started it locally against QA.

capex_rationale: Every capex project is pre-release or actively adding capability. Sales-intelligence-platform is explicitly in alpha. Spark-mobile-app is in beta with its TestFlight release workflow being set up. App-distribution-website is deployed but not open to users pending Auth0. Fix and hardening PRs on those products are development-stage work. Small haircuts cover configuration-only and documentation-only PRs.
opex_rationale: Claude-setup is upkeep of the developer tooling pipeline: prerequisites documentation, a model migration, prompt tuning, and backlog cleanup. It produces no product asset. B2b-ecommerce-cc was an assessment of an existing codebase, not construction.
